file_upload_prompts.label: Upload AHA, SDS, or prior tool box talks

sections.label: Briefing Details
sections.instructions: ONLY a two-column markdown table: Project, Job #, Briefing Location, Briefing Time, Conducted By, Reference Documents (omit the last row if not provided). No prose.

sections.label: Attendees
sections.instructions: A markdown table: Name | Role / Company | Signature / Initials, one row per attendee (leave the signature cell blank for wet-ink sign-off).

sections.label: Today's Work Scope
sections.instructions: A tight bullet list, one item per line of work_scope. Operational and specific; no narrative padding.

sections.label: Hazards Reviewed & Controls Confirmed
sections.instructions: A markdown table: Hazard | Controls Confirmed In Place, one row per pipe-delimited line of hazards_controls. Reproduce regulatory citations exactly as provided.

sections.label: PPE Required — Verified Issued and Worn
sections.instructions: Render each ppe_required line as a '- [x] …' markdown checkbox item. Omit if not provided.

sections.label: Specific Topics Discussed
sections.instructions: Render each topics_discussed line as a '- [x] …' markdown checkbox item. Omit if not provided.

sections.label: Notes / Discussion
sections.instructions: Short paragraphs or bullets from notes. Omit if not provided.

sections.label: Acknowledgment
sections.instructions: Two parallel blocks: 'Briefing Conducted By' (from conducted_by) and 'Crew Acknowledgment' (the lead attendee) — each name, title, company, then 'Signature & Date'.
